title: Topic 5
japanese_text: 最近ＳＮＳで<u>やたら</u>目にするアイドルが、ＡＩで<u>生成された</u>架空の人物だと知った。<u>あたかも</u>存在しているかのように<u>拡散されている</u>ことに恐怖を感じた。
english_translation: I recently learned that an idol I'd been seeing so much on social media was a fictitious person generated by AI. I was scared to learn that they were being circulated as if they actually existed.
